mainEntity.name: How do I know which county my Maiden property is in?

acceptedAnswer.text: The county tax record for the parcel. Catawba County's office is in Newton; Lincoln County's is in Lincolnton. The septic permit is with whichever county the parcel sits in.

mainEntity.name: Can you inspect the septic and test the well on the same visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The septic inspection is this site's service; well water testing is added through Inspect-All Home Inspections, and both happen in one trip.

mainEntity.name: Do you cover the Lincoln County side, toward Lincolnton and Denver?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Maiden area on both sides of the line is part of my service area, and I'll go further into Lincoln County on request.
